Valtorum may deny authorization without providing a reason based on internal policy and risk assessment. Once USDV is validly issued to an authorized account, Valtorum cannot freeze, claw back, reverse, seize, confiscate, forcibly burn, or recover USDV. This is a core structural feature of USDV. Individuals seeking authorization are encouraged to apply through a protocol or institution with an existing Valtorum relationship where onboarding may be streamlined.
